title: Tennis Matches + Odds, Form & Head-to-Head
description: List ATP and WTA matches for a day (schedule or finished results), optionally joined to each match's detail page: bookmaker odds, rankings, form, surface record, and head-to-head.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `schedule` lists the day's upcoming, live, and completed matches. `results` lists only finished matches for the day. `live` lists only matches in progress right now, with the current set scores (a snapshot; run again for an update). `live` ignores `date` and `days`.

date.title: Date
date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today (UTC). Dates are the site's Central European calendar day.

days.title: Days
days.description: How many consecutive days to list, starting at `date`. 1 to 14.

tour.title: Tour
tour.description: ATP (men), WTA (women), or both. Includes Challenger, ITF, and UTR events listed under each tour.

doubles.title: Doubles instead of singles
doubles.description: Return doubles matches instead of singles.

tournament.title: Tournament contains
tournament.description: Case-insensitive substring of the tournament name, e.g. `US Open`, `Challenger`, `Wimbledon`.

player.title: Player contains
player.description: Case-insensitive substring of either player's listed name, e.g. `Alcaraz`.

status.title: Status
status.description: Keep only matches in this state. Leave empty for all.

maxMatches.title: Max matches
maxMatches.description: Stop after this many matches. Each enriched match is one extra request (about one second).

enrich.title: Enrich each match
enrich.description: Fetch every match's detail page: round, surface, rankings, this year's W/L by surface, head-to-head history, 15+ bookmakers' current and opening odds, both players' latest matches and form. Charged as `enriched-match` instead of `match`.

latestMatches.title: Latest matches per player
latestMatches.description: How many recent matches to include for each player when enriching (1 to 30).

oddsHistory.title: Include odds movement history
oddsHistory.description: Add every recorded odds change per bookmaker (timestamped, site time). Larger rows.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Delay between requests (seconds)
requestDelaySeconds.description: Politeness delay toward the source site. Lower is faster but risks throttling.

archiveDatasetName.title: Also append to a named dataset
archiveDatasetName.description: Optional. Name of a dataset in your account to append every returned row to, so scheduled runs build a history that outlives run-data retention. Not charged again.
